shelf.q: What is the Digital Reading Shelf?
shelf.a: A digital reading shelf of CakraNexa backlist and selected titles as e-books and audiobooks. It is open to Professional & Academic Society members and institutions, without buying each title.

audioHours.a: Every audiobook on the shelf is open to paid plans, limited by hours per month: Silver 5 hours, Gold 20 hours, Platinum 60 hours per account. Hours count the length of book content played, not how long you listen, so listening at 2× uses your hours twice as fast. Samples do not count. Annual plans are also counted per month. When your hours run out, playback stops and you can upgrade or wait for next month’s hours.

frontlist.q: Why don't new titles join the shelf right away?
frontlist.a: New titles are sold as single copies first for {{min}}–{{max}} days so authors are paid fairly. After that a title joins the shelf, and the date is shown on its product page.

unitPurchase.q: Can I buy an e-book without a membership?
unitPurchase.a: Yes. Every available e-book and audiobook can be bought as a single copy and stays in My Library for good. Members get member prices, which cannot be combined with a wallet.

billing.q: What is the difference between monthly and annual billing?
billing.a: Annual billing is paid once a year at the price of 10 months, so you save 2 months compared with monthly billing.

founding.q: What is the Founding Member price?
founding.a: A launch price for the first annual members: Reader Circle {{reader}} (first {{readerCap}} members), Professional & Academic Society {{professional}} (first {{professionalCap}} members), and Author Guild {{author}} (first {{authorCap}} members). It applies to the first year. Renewals use the regular price, and we let you know {{noticeDays}} days in advance.

payment.a: Credit cards and GoPay renew automatically. Virtual Accounts and QRIS renew manually; we send reminders {{d1}}, {{d2}}, and {{d3}} days before the due date and on the due date.
payment.aManual: For now every method (Virtual Account, QRIS, card, and GoPay) is paid each period: we issue an invoice and send reminders {{d1}}, {{d2}}, and {{d3}} days before the due date and on the due date. Automatic renewal by card and GoPay will open once Midtrans activation is complete.

grace.q: What if a payment is late?
grace.a: There is a {{graceDays}}-day grace period and your access stays open. After that access is locked, but your reading progress and notes are kept for {{retentionMonths}} months and reconnect as soon as you pay.

changePlan.a: Yes. Upgrades take effect immediately with a prorated payment for the difference. Downgrades take effect from the next billing period.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes, directly from your account page. Your membership stays active until the end of the period you paid for, and there is no further charge. Titles bought as single copies remain yours.

devices.q: On how many devices can I read?
devices.a: Digital Reading Shelf access and single-copy titles can be opened on {{devices}} devices. There is one active reading or listening session per title, and a device can be released once every {{releaseDays}} days. There are no PDF downloads; all access is through the cloud reader and player.

membershipTerms.title: Cakrawala Magna Society Membership Terms
membershipTerms.intro: These terms apply to CakraNexa paid memberships operated by PT Cakrawala Magna Scientia. This document is a draft and may change before sign-up opens.

plans.title: 1. Plans and prices
plans.body: Membership consists of Free Circle (free), Reader Circle, Professional & Academic Society, and Author Guild. Each plan's price, benefits, and device limit are shown on the membership page when you sign up. The annual price equals 10 times the monthly price. All prices are in Indonesian Rupiah.

founding.title: 2. Founding Member pricing
founding.body: Founding pricing applies to the first year of an annual plan for new members while seats last: Reader Circle {{reader}} ({{readerCap}} members), Professional & Academic Society {{professional}} ({{professionalCap}} members), and Author Guild {{author}} ({{authorCap}} members). A seat is reserved at sign-up and released if the first invoice is not paid within 24 hours. Later years use the regular price; we notify you {{noticeDays}} days in advance.

billing.title: 3. Billing and renewal
billing.body: The membership period starts when the first payment succeeds. For manual payment (Virtual Account, QRIS), the renewal invoice is issued {{d1}} days before the period ends, with reminders {{d1}}, {{d2}}, and {{d3}} days before and on the due date. For card or GoPay with automatic renewal (when available), the charge is made at the end of the period and retried for up to 3 days if it fails. Payments are processed by Midtrans; CakraNexa never stores card data.

grace.title: 4. Grace period and locked access
grace.body: If an invoice is unpaid on the due date, the membership enters a {{graceDays}}-day grace period and access stays open. After that, membership access is locked. Reading progress and notes are kept for {{retentionMonths}} months and reconnect when you subscribe again at the regular price.

changes.title: 5. Changing plans
changes.body: Upgrades and monthly-to-annual changes take effect immediately: the unused value of the current period becomes a prorated credit, and a new period starts on the day the difference is paid. Downgrades and annual-to-monthly changes take effect at the end of the current period. If your active devices exceed the new plan's limit, you will be asked to release a device.

cancel.title: 6. Cancellation
cancel.body: You can cancel at any time from My Membership without contacting an administrator. Access stays open until the end of the paid period, there is no further invoice, and you can undo the cancellation before the period ends. Payments for the current period are not refunded, except where required by law.

digital.title: 7. Digital access and devices
digital.body: The Digital Reading Shelf and Digital Member Pick are a personal reading/listening licence while the membership is active, through the cloud reader and player with no file downloads. Each title can be open in one active session, on devices within the plan limit, with an account watermark. A device can be released once every {{releaseDays}} days. Misuse (such as account sharing or automated page turning) may suspend access. Titles bought individually remain yours after the membership ends.

frontlist.title: 8. New titles (frontlist)
frontlist.body: New titles are sold individually for {{min}}–{{max}} days before they join the Digital Reading Shelf. The shelf entry date is shown on each product page.

privacy.title: 9. Personal data
privacy.body: We process your name, email, and billing history to manage your membership, and access logs to protect content. Card and e-wallet details are processed only by Midtrans.

updates.title: 10. Changes to these terms
updates.body: Changes to prices or terms are announced by email before they apply to your next renewal.

contact.title: 11. Contact
contact.body: Questions about membership can be sent through the CakraNexa Contact page.

accountMembership.title: My Membership
accountMembership.subtitle: Your plan, invoices, renewals, and cancellation.
accountMembership.loginTitle: Sign in to view your membership
accountMembership.loginDescription: Your membership and invoices are linked to your account.
accountMembership.loadError: Membership details could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.

none.title: No paid membership yet
none.description: Your account includes Free Circle. Choose a plan to unlock the Digital Reading Shelf or Digital Member Pick.

accountMembership.renewalManual: The invoice is sent 7 days before.
accountMembership.foundingUntil: Founding pricing applies until {{date}}. The next renewal uses the regular price of {{price}}/year.
accountMembership.pendingNotice: Your sign-up is awaiting payment. Complete it within 24 hours to activate the membership.
accountMembership.graceNotice: Your invoice is unpaid. Access stays open until {{date}} (grace period).
accountMembership.pastDueNotice: Automatic payment failed. We will retry over the next few days; you can also pay now.
accountMembership.canceledNotice: Membership canceled. Access stays open until {{date}} and there is no further invoice.
accountMembership.endedNotice: Membership ended on {{date}}. Your progress and notes are kept for {{months}} months; subscribe again to unlock them.
accountMembership.resumed: Cancellation undone. Your membership continues as usual.

openInvoice.title: Open invoice
openInvoice.stillPending: We have not received the payment yet. If you just paid, wait a few minutes and check again.

change.title: Change plan
change.description: Upgrades and monthly-to-annual changes apply immediately with a prorated credit. Downgrades and annual-to-monthly changes apply at the end of the period.
change.immediateResult: Pay the difference of {{amount}} (after a {{credit}} credit) to activate the new plan.

method.title: Payment method
method.description: Applies to the next invoice. Card/GoPay renew automatically once that feature is active.
method.saved: Payment method updated for the next invoice.

cancel.title: Cancel membership
cancel.description: Access stays open until {{date}}. There is no further invoice, and titles you bought individually remain yours.
cancel.descriptionNow: This period's invoice is unpaid, so cancelling ends membership access immediately.
cancel.confirm: Cancel your membership? Membership access ends on {{date}}.

errors.no_subscription: You do not have an active membership.
errors.no_change: The plan and billing period are the same as now.
errors.canceled: Undo the cancellation first to schedule a plan change.
errors.nothing_to_resume: There is no cancellation to undo.

errors.invoice_closed: This invoice can no longer be paid.
errors.payment_unavailable: Online payment is not available yet.
errors.payment_error: Payment could not be started. Please try again.
errors.no_pending_change: There is no scheduled plan change.
errors.snap_unavailable: The payment page could not be opened. Disable your popup blocker and try again.
errors.network: Connection lost. Check your internet and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.invalid_whatsapp: Invalid WhatsApp number. Use an Indonesian mobile number, for example 0812 3456 7890.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp reminders
whatsapp.description: Invoice reminders (7, 3 and 1 days before and on the due date), grace period, and locked-access notices are sent from CakraNexa's official number {{sender}}. Email is still sent.
whatsapp.saved: WhatsApp reminders are on for this number.
whatsapp.off: WhatsApp reminders are off. Reminders are still sent by email.
